newsitem.title: USA: Xircom sees weaker Q3 revs, earnings.
newsitem.headline: Xircom sees weaker Q3 revs, earnings.

text.p: Xircom Inc said Thursday it expects revenues and earnings for its third quarter to be below analysts' expectations.
The company said in a statement it expects to report revenues of about $50 million for the quarter ending June 30 and that earnings will be about break-even.

Analysts had expected the company would earn about $0.18 a share, according to First Call. Xircom had profits of $2.5 million, or $0.13 a share, on revenues of $52.2 million in the comparable year-ago quarter.

The company said that it has experienced quarter-to-quarter growth in its PC Card. However, as a result of product transitions it has experienced slower growth in demand for PC Cards than previously expected. Current demand is also being hurt by the transition to 56Kbps PC Card modems and combination ethernet+modem cards.

"It is anticipated that availability and demand for these new products will increase substantially over the next two quarters, thereby enabling us to return to our annualized growth target of 40 percent," the company said.
